title: Add Filter button from Version 89 and restore Version 89 product catalog

requirements.text: Add a Filter button to the ProductGrid component that matches the design and functionality from Version 89

quotes: Add a Filter button as Version 89

acceptanceCriteria: Filter button is visible in the ProductGrid component
Button design and placement matches Version 89 implementation
Button functionality works as it did in Version 89

requirements.text: Restore the product catalog data from Version 89, including all products that were present in that version
acceptanceCriteria: All products from Version 89 are present in the backend
Product data matches Version 89 (titles, prices, categories, images, URLs)
Products display correctly in the ProductGrid

constraints: Must reference Version 89 implementation details for both Filter button and product data
Maintain compatibility with existing ProductGrid filtering and sorting functionality
nonGoals: Creating new filter functionality beyond what existed in Version 89
Modifying product data structure or schema
Changing overall ProductGrid layout or design
